idea-plugin.name: Editor Peer Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Editor Peer Bridge is a local cross-editor navigation bridge for Rider, VS Code, Cursor, and CodeBuddy.

Use one action to send the current file and selection to a matching peer editor in the same workspace. The plugin supports multi-target routing, an "All" broadcast option, manual Create/Update Config, Rider solution detection, and multiple editor instances.

Communication stays on localhost; file paths and selections are not uploaded to external services.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.0.19

  • Before jumping, the client verifies the target peer on the configured port and searches the port range when session-only fallback left a stale port.
  • Incoming HTTP handlers now match against the on-disk config, so workspace-root edits take effect without restarting the server.

0.0.18

  • Config writes are manual only (Create / Update Config). Startup and file watching no longer rewrite the shared config.
  • Removed automatic config backups; Update Config deletes leftover .bak.* files.
  • Port fallback on bind conflict is session-only and is not persisted to the config file.
  • Open-ended Rider compatibility (no until-build upper bound).
